title: MarkdownRetirementPolicy
description: Policy for retiring hand-authored Markdown from the repo per user directive 2026-05-13. README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md are the only repo-root machine-readable pointer hubs. HANDOFF.md is retained as a bounded fresh-session handoff exception recorded in retention_rules.bounded_root_markdown_exceptions; it is not a fourth pointer hub. Everything else under docs/, .omc/, contracts/, etc. becomes JSON/TOML/YAML with the active-artifact-contract v3.0.0 9-capability declaration. Per autonomous-prompt directive 'target 0 hand-authored Markdown'.

user_directives_2026_05_13_cascade: the only thing that we should maintain is a README.md
that should utilize machine readable pointers to relevent files
_meta.purpose: Policy for retiring hand-authored Markdown from the repo per user directive 2026-05-13. README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md are the only repo-root machine-readable pointer hubs; HANDOFF.md remains only as a bounded fresh-session handoff exception with owner, lifecycle, and freshness rules below. Everything else under docs/, .omc/, contracts/, etc.

bounded_root_markdown_exceptions.decision: retain at repo root until the cross-repo state, backlog, guardrails, and consolidation map are migrated to a machine-readable successor or expire as completed/superseded state
source_of_truth_rationale: Founder directive 2026-06-08 recorded in HANDOFF.md: fresh sessions need cross-repo state, full backlog, hard guardrails, and sibling/kernel consolidation map with zero context loss.
specs/root-hub-pointers.json entry_points.session_handoff registers HANDOFF.md as the current fresh-session handoff entry.
git tracked root Markdown inventory as of 2026-07-01 contains AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md, and README.md.
bounded_root_markdown_exceptions.authority_boundary: HANDOFF.md may summarize current state/backlog for session re-entry, but it must not override README.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, docs/AGENTS.md, accepted ADRs, or machine-readable specs/registries.
bounded_root_markdown_exceptions.freshness_rule: Audit when root-hub pointers or repo-hygiene automation are updated, and otherwise treat claims older than 30 days as stale unless refreshed by a governance/docs task.
bounded_root_markdown_exceptions.retirement_rule: Prefer migration to a machine-readable session-handoff registry; after equivalent state is preserved there, remove HANDOFF.md from the root allowlist in this policy, specs/root-hub-pointers.json, and specs/repo-hygiene-automation.json in one cohesion slice.
bounded_root_markdown_exceptions.expansion_rule: No additional root Markdown files are allowed by analogy; every new exception needs an explicit policy row with owner, lifecycle, and retirement rule.

honest_gaps: Some Markdown semantic content (prose explanations, narrative ADR Context sections) does not naturally project to JSON without loss. Mitigation: each registry row carries a `body_markdown_archived_at` field pointing to the historical .md preserved under .git history; JSON instances carry the EXTRACTED structured fields only.

Existing tooling (rustdoc, mdbook, IDE Markdown previews) is markdown-aware. Replacement tooling (JSON-rendering UIs, generated HTML from JSON) is foundation-prerequisite per Wave 1 docs portal v7 + ADR-0066.
External-facing docs (anything published to https://docs.oyatie.com) is foundation-side; this policy covers repo-internal docs only. Public docs site can render from JSON via Leptos SSR per ADR-0065.
